notes.title: Voice Cast Announcement for Project Songbird!
notes.content: [p]Hey there![/p][p]I'm incredibly honored and excited to announce the full voice cast for [i]Project Songbird![/i][/p][p][/p][p]It's so wild to have been able to work with these amazing actors to bring my story to life, and they all did such an amazing job with making that a reality.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257710/615afbefff13a90645209a5d4ffe284795e0577f.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]In the leading role of our protagonist Dakota, we have the one and only Valerie Rose Lohman ([i]What Remains of Edith Finch, Wolfenstein: Youngblood[/i])[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257710/1d64c6717440762f0197172c295e1c228343f9ee.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Next is the return of my good friend Jonah Scott ([i]Beastars, Dying Light 2[/i]) as Rob, Dakota's manager![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257710/571749e07d5340e18f85b43c1ac4387dcea679a7.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Following that up, the ever-talented Aleks Le ([i]Persona 3: Reloaded, DanDaDan, Solo Leveling[/i]) has joined the cast to play the part of Dakota's younger brother, Finn![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257710/935b7855196659248b7f287c741d45e062dc50fa.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Rounding out the supporting cast, we have not one, but TWO members of the hit D&D live Show [/p][/*][*][p]The Twenty-Sided Tavern!  Those Being Madelyn Murphy and Will Champion![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257710/3b2e3c46282741f78ff4f960ad5d2439ccb70eab.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257710/7e3c278932d04d5655c8cdb442a536052cfbd7f7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I'd also like to give an additional shoutout to Christian La Monte ([i]Fire Emblem: Engage[/i]) for an excellent featured monologue, and to Jenny Yokobori ([i]The Simpsons, Genshin Impact[/i]) for not only helping me conduct the casting and auditioning process, but also co-directing during the recording sessions; I couldn't have done it without you![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for the support, and be sure to tune in on Sept. 30th to the Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase where I'll be hosting and debuting a brand new trailer![/p][p][/p][p]Can't wait to see you there :)[/p][p][/p][p]Conner Rush[/p]

notes.title: Project Songbird is Coming to Consoles!!!
notes.content: [p]I can't believe I finally get to share this![/p][p][/p][p]I'm honored to announce that Project Songbird will not only be launching on Steam, but PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S as well![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257710/d7436d01f1de1136377f144ec5deca8dc2c2cdb4.png"][/img][/p][p]It's been a goal and a dream of mine for the longest time to have one of my games released on consoles, and it feels so surreal that this is finally happening!  I've partnered with the Spanish game publisher Dojo System (publisher of [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2430900/Among_Ashes/"]Among Ashes[/url]) to bring this experience to home consoles.[/p][p][/p][p]The [url="https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10016429/"]PlayStation Store Page[/url] is available now, with the Xbox storefront coming soon!  Wishlists either here or on PlayStation are more helpful than you can imagine, so I'd sincerely appreciate you doing so![/p][p][/p][p]I have so much more news that I can't wait to share as well.  All in due time...[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for all the support, and I can't wait to write y'all again :).[/p][p][/p][p]Conner Rush[/p]

notes.title: Project Songbird is Attending the Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase!
notes.content: [p]Hello!  Conner here!  [/p][p][/p][p]I am so excited to announce that Project Songbird will be taking part in the Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase, co-streamed by IGN!  I cannot be more grateful to The Horror Game Awards for extending to me this opportunity to showcase all of the progress being made on Project Songbird.[/p][p][/p][p]During this showcase, I'll be unveiling a brand new story trailer as well as many release details that I'm just DYING to share.  You're not gonna want to miss it.[/p][p][/p][p]The Halloween Showcase will be broadcast on Sept. 30th @ 2:00pm Eastern US Time via The Horror Game Awards, IGN, and numerous other co-streamers![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://thehorrorgameawards.com/"]https://thehorrorgameawards.com/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Dread XP's Indie Horror Showcase 2024
notes.content:
I'm ecstatic to announce that the first look at gameplay for [b][i]Project Songbird [/i][/b] will be airing via the Dread XP Indie Horror Showcase 2024 in collaboration with The MIX!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180410/Project_Songbird/

Hosted by everyone's favorite horror game content creator John Wolfe, this live stream will feature works from the publishers and developers behind games such as [i][b]Slay the Princess, Rain World, I Have No Mouth and I Must Scream, Martha is Dead, Silkbulb Test[/b][/i], and many many more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257710/664d37852dc5d242a0ccf1b0d139015dc03c072e.jpg[/img]

You can watch the full event [url=https://www.indiehorrorshowcase.com/][u][b]HERE[/b][/u][/url] on [b]October 24th at 10:00am PST / 1:00pm EST[/b]!  See ya there!

[b]Conner Rush[/b]
